responsibility: Computes IRA’s register-class, hard-register, and memory costs for allocnos and pseudos. It analyzes insn operands and alternatives to determine important cost classes, preferred classes, per-class move/memory costs, and equivalence gains; initializes reusable target cost buffers; and later tunes allocno hard-register costs for call crossings and alignment preferences. The results produced here drive allocno class selection, profitability of specific hard registers, and later coloring or pseudo-class setup.
